question: What is the primary purpose of a Social Audit Report?
options: To provide a marketing brochure for the NGO
To provide an independent opinion on the reliability of the impact reported by the Social Enterprise
To list the personal bank accounts of the trustees
To provide a detailed diary of the auditor's travel
answer: To provide an independent opinion on the reliability of the impact reported by the Social Enterprise
hint: यह stakeholders के लिए एक formal assurance document है।
explanation: Social Audit Report एक formal document है जहाँ auditor Social Enterprise द्वारा किए गए social impact दावों (claims) के संबंध में अपना conclusion व्यक्त (express) करता है।

question: Which of the following is a key component of a Social Audit Report?
options: Audit Objectives and Scope
Methodology used for assessment
Findings and Audit Opinion
All of the above
answer: All of the above
hint: एक पूरी report में यह बताना ज़रूरी है कि क्या किया गया, कैसे किया गया, और क्या पाया गया।
explanation: एक professional report में scope, data इकट्ठा करने के लिए इस्तेमाल किए गए methods, और अंतिम professional opinion शामिल होना चाहिए।

question: The 'Annual Impact Report' (AIR) is primarily the responsibility of:
options: The Social Auditor
The Social Enterprise (NPO/FPE)
SEBI
The Stock Exchange
answer: The Social Enterprise (NPO/FPE)
hint: Entity अपने impact की रिपोर्ट खुद देती है; auditor उसकी जाँच करता है।
explanation: Social Enterprise सालाना SSE पर अपनी AIR तैयार करने और उसे disclose करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

question: Listed NPOs must submit their Annual Impact Report within how many days from the end of the financial year?
options: 30 days
60 days
90 days
180 days
answer: 90 days
hint: 31 मार्च के बाद लगभग 3 महीने।
explanation: SEBI regulations के अनुसार, financial year खत्म होने के 90 दिनों के भीतर AIR को disclose किया जाना चाहिए।

question: The Social Audit Report must state the 'Period' covered by the audit.
options: True
False
Only if it's more than one year
Only if requested by the donor
answer: True
hint: Users को यह जानना ज़रूरी है कि परिणाम (results) किस समय-सीमा (timeframe) के हैं।
explanation: Context और comparison के लिए audit period (जैसे, FY 2025-26) को define करना बहुत ज़रूरी है।

question: What does an 'Unqualified Opinion' in a social audit report signify?
options: The auditor is not qualified to do the job
The impact report is fairly presented and free from material misstatement
The NGO has failed its goals
The data is completely missing
answer: The impact report is fairly presented and free from material misstatement
hint: Auditing में, 'Unqualified' का मतलब वास्तव में 'Good' या 'Clean' status होता है।
explanation: Unqualified opinion का मतलब है कि auditor ने impact report को सभी material respects में reliable (विश्वसनीय) और सटीक (accurate) पाया।

question: A 'Qualified Opinion' is issued when:
options: The auditor is very happy with the results
There are specific areas of disagreement or lack of evidence, but the rest of the report is reliable
The NGO wins a national award
The report is 100% perfect
answer: There are specific areas of disagreement or lack of evidence, but the rest of the report is reliable
hint: यह एक 'Yes, but...' (हाँ, लेकिन...) वाले बयान की तरह है।
explanation: Qualified opinion तब दिया जाता है जब auditor को impact report के कुछ specific हिस्सों को लेकर संदेह (reservations) होता है।

question: Which of the following must be disclosed in the AIR regarding 'Fund Utilization'?
options: Amount of funds raised and amount actually spent on the project
The bank manager's name
The color of the currency notes
The list of all shops where items were bought
answer: Amount of funds raised and amount actually spent on the project
hint: Investors जानना चाहते हैं कि क्या उनका पैसा project तक पहुँचा।
explanation: AIR को यह disclose करना चाहिए कि SSE के माध्यम से कितना पैसा (funds) जुटाया गया और उसे social activities के लिए कैसे इस्तेमाल (deploy) किया गया।

question: The 'Management Representation Letter' is a document where:
options: The auditor promises to be fair
The NGO management confirms that they have provided all necessary info honestly
The donor gives a testimonial
The beneficiaries sign a thank you note
answer: The NGO management confirms that they have provided all necessary info honestly
hint: यह data की सच्चाई की ज़िम्मेदारी management पर डालता है।
explanation: यह letter audit evidence का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है जहाँ management साझा की गई (shared) जानकारी की ज़िम्मेदारी लेता है।

question: What is the role of 'Disclosures' in a social impact report?
options: To hide the failures of the NGO
To provide transparency about governance, financials, and impact
To make the report look colorful
To satisfy the local police
answer: To provide transparency about governance, financials, and impact
hint: Transparency (पारदर्शिता) SSE का मूल (core) है।
explanation: Disclosures stakeholders को enterprise के वास्तविक performance और structure के आधार पर informed decisions लेने में मदद करते हैं।

question: The Annual Impact Report should ideally be aligned with which global framework for better comparability?
options: UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
The local municipal register
The NGO's internal social media goals
None of the above
answer: UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
hint: यह social change के लिए universal 'language' है।
explanation: AIR को SDGs के साथ align करने से global और national investors को व्यापक लक्ष्यों (broader goals) में project के योगदान को समझने में मदद मिलती है।

question: Which section of the report describes 'How' the impact data was collected?
options: Introduction
Methodology
Financials
Conclusion
answer: Methodology
hint: यह 'method' या 'process' को समझाता है।
explanation: Methodology section बताता है कि auditor ने surveys, interviews, site visits या secondary data का इस्तेमाल किया है या नहीं।

question: What is a 'Disclaimer of Opinion'?
options: A perfect score for the NGO
When the auditor cannot form an opinion due to lack of sufficient evidence
When the auditor suggests a new project
A legal case against the auditor
answer: When the auditor cannot form an opinion due to lack of sufficient evidence
hint: Auditor कहता है, 'मेरे पास यह बताने के लिए पर्याप्त जानकारी नहीं है कि यह सही है या गलत।'
explanation: यदि records इतने खराब हैं कि auditor किसी भी चीज़ को verify नहीं कर सकता, तो वे एक disclaimer issue करते हैं।

question: The AIR must be hosted on the website of ________.
options: The Social Enterprise
The Stock Exchange
Both A and B
The Auditor's personal blog
answer: Both A and B
hint: Transparency के लिए public accessibility महत्वपूर्ण है।
explanation: SEBI के नियमों के अनुसार AIRs का enterprise की website और SSE segment website दोनों पर publicly available होना ज़रूरी है।

question: Which of the following is an example of an 'Impact Metric' found in a report?
options: Number of children whose reading level improved from Grade 1 to Grade 3
The number of computers in the office
The age of the NGO founder
The electricity bill of the NGO
answer: Number of children whose reading level improved from Grade 1 to Grade 3
hint: यह target group में आए 'बदलाव' (change) को मापता है।
explanation: सार्थक (Meaningful) metrics केवल inputs या office assets के बजाय परिणामों (outcomes/improvements) पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं।

question: The Social Audit Report must be addressed to ________.
options: The local community
The Board of Directors/Trustees of the Social Enterprise
The Prime Minister
The individual donors
answer: The Board of Directors/Trustees of the Social Enterprise
hint: Auditor उस entity की governing body को रिपोर्ट करता है जिसका audit किया जा रहा है।
explanation: औपचारिक (Formally) रूप से, audit report board को सौंपी जाती है, जो enterprise के governance के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

question: A Social Auditor's report must include their 'NISM' certification number and 'SRO' registration number.
options: True
False
Only if they are auditing a for-profit enterprise
Only if they are from a big firm
answer: True
hint: यह साबित करता है कि auditor report पर हस्ताक्षर (sign) करने के लिए अधिकृत (authorized) है।
explanation: ये identifiers सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि audit एक qualified और मान्यता प्राप्त (recognized) professional द्वारा किया गया है।

question: What is 'Materiality' in reporting?
options: Reporting every single small detail
Focusing on the information that is most significant to stakeholders' understanding of impact
Reporting the physical materials used in building
The cost of the report printing
answer: Focusing on the information that is most significant to stakeholders' understanding of impact
hint: महत्वपूर्ण तथ्यों (facts) को छोटी-छोटी डिटेल्स के समुद्र में न छिपाएं।
explanation: Materiality यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि report उन बातों पर केंद्रित रहे जो वास्तव में decision-making के लिए मायने रखती हैं।

question: Which of the following is NOT required in the Annual Impact Report?
options: Details of the social problem being addressed
The names and home addresses of every single beneficiary
Actual impact vs targets set
Governance structure
answer: The names and home addresses of every single beneficiary
hint: Beneficiary की privacy और confidentiality को बनाए रखना चाहिए।
explanation: हालांकि aggregated impact data की आवश्यकता होती है, लेकिन beneficiaries की personal private details को public reports में disclose नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।

question: What is an 'Adverse Opinion'?
options: A very positive review
When the auditor concludes that the impact report is misleading and does not represent the truth
When the auditor likes the project but not the NGO
When the report is too long
answer: When the auditor concludes that the impact report is misleading and does not represent the truth
hint: यह सबसे negative opinion है जो एक auditor दे सकता है।
explanation: Adverse opinion तब दिया जाता है जब auditor को reporting में महत्वपूर्ण और व्यापक (pervasive) गलतियां या झूठ (falsehoods) मिलते हैं।

question: The 'Stakeholder Engagement' section of the report should mention:
options: Which groups were consulted during the audit
The menu of the stakeholder meeting
The personal opinions of the auditor's family
The list of all people who didn't attend the meeting
answer: Which groups were consulted during the audit
hint: यह दिखाता है कि किनकी आवाज़ (voices) सुनी गई।
explanation: Engagement पर reporting यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि audit में उन लोगों को शामिल किया गया है जो project से सबसे ज़्यादा प्रभावित हैं।

question: What is 'Comparability' in social reporting?
options: Comparing the NGO to a for-profit tech company
The ability for a reader to compare the SE's performance over time or against other SEs
Making sure all reports are the same color
Using the same words in every sentence
answer: The ability for a reader to compare the SE's performance over time or against other SEs
hint: Standardized metrics 'apples-to-apples' (सटीक) तुलना की अनुमति देते हैं।
explanation: Investors के लिए यह evaluate करने के लिए Comparability आवश्यक है कि impact create करने में कौन से enterprises सबसे अधिक प्रभावी (effective) हैं।

question: Can the Social Audit Report be used for 'Promotional' purposes by the NGO?
options: Yes, as long as it's not misrepresented
No, it's a confidential document
Only if the auditor says it's 100% perfect
Only if it's published in the newspaper
answer: Yes, as long as it's not misrepresented
hint: Credible (विश्वसनीय) audits स्वाभाविक रूप से NGO का brand बनाते हैं।
explanation: रिपोर्ट एक public document है; NGOs भरोसा कायम करने के लिए findings का उपयोग कर सकते हैं, बशर्ते (provided) वे auditor के opinion को सटीक (accurately) रूप से प्रस्तुत करें।

question: Which document outlines the 'Audit Standards' to be followed for reporting?
options: Social Audit Standards (SAS) issued by ICAI
The Income Tax Act
The local NGO handbook
The stock exchange holiday list
answer: Social Audit Standards (SAS) issued by ICAI
hint: ISAI/ICAI इन standards के लिए professional body है।
explanation: SAS भारत में social audits के संचालन और रिपोर्टिंग के लिए professional framework प्रदान करते हैं।

question: What is a 'Draft' Social Audit Report?
options: A report that is thrown away
A preliminary version shared with management to check for factual accuracy before finalization
A report written on a napkin
A report only for the staff
answer: A preliminary version shared with management to check for factual accuracy before finalization
hint: यह 'final' version आने से पहले entity को facts स्पष्ट (clarify) करने का मौका देता है।
explanation: Draft साझा करने से यह सुनिश्चित करने में मदद मिलती है कि अंतिम public document में कोई सामान्य तथ्यात्मक (factual) गलतियाँ न हों।

question: The Annual Impact Report must include a 'Narrative' explanation of the impact.
options: True
False
Only if there are no numbers
Only for environmental projects
answer: True
hint: केवल नंबर पूरी कहानी नहीं बताते; context को समझाने के लिए आपको शब्दों की ज़रूरत होती है।
explanation: एक narrative reader को impact की 'story', सामने आई चुनौतियों (challenges), और program के तर्क (logic) को समझने में मदद करता है।

question: What is the 'Basis for Opinion' section in the audit report?
options: A list of the auditor's favorite books
The explanation of why the auditor reached their conclusion, including the evidence used
The NGO's bank balance
A list of the auditor's complaints
answer: The explanation of why the auditor reached their conclusion, including the evidence used
hint: यह 'Clean' या 'Qualified' status के पीछे का कारण बताता है।
explanation: यह section उन professional standards को समझाता है जिनका पालन किया गया और opinion का समर्थन करने के लिए जो evidence जुटाए गए।

question: If an NPO has multiple projects, the AIR must cover:
options: Only the most successful project
Only the project funded via the SSE
All social activities of the organization
Only the projects in the head office city
answer: All social activities of the organization
hint: AIR registered entity का एक समग्र (holistic) दृष्टिकोण प्रदान करता है।
explanation: Annual Impact Report में entity के impact की पूरी तस्वीर प्रदान करने के लिए सभी social activities को शामिल किया जाना चाहिए।

question: What is 'Reliability' in the context of Chapter 7?
options: The auditor's car being on time
Information that is accurate, verifiable, and free from bias
Using the same printer for 5 years
Having a fast internet connection
answer: Information that is accurate, verifiable, and free from bias
hint: क्या reader जानकारी पर 'भरोसा' (trust) कर सकता है?
explanation: Reliable reporting यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि stakeholders अपने decision-making के लिए data पर निर्भर रह सकते हैं।

question: What is 'Balance' in a social impact report?
options: Standing on one leg
The bank balance of the NGO
Reporting both positive results and the challenges or negative impacts
Having an equal number of pages in each chapter
answer: Reporting both positive results and the challenges or negative impacts
hint: केवल अच्छी ख़बरें (good news) ही साझा न करें।
explanation: एक balanced report एक निष्पक्ष (fair) और objective दृष्टिकोण प्रदान करती है, जिसमें वे बातें भी शामिल होती हैं जो योजना के अनुसार नहीं हुईं।

question: The Social Audit Report must be 'Signed' by ________.
options: The NGO CEO only
The Individual Social Auditor or the partner of the Social Audit Firm
The project's head student
The local Mayor
answer: The Individual Social Auditor or the partner of the Social Audit Firm
hint: जिस professional ने audit किया है उसे ज़िम्मेदारी लेनी चाहिए।
explanation: Signature report की सामग्री (contents) के लिए auditor की professional accountability की पुष्टि (confirms) करता है।

question: In AIR reporting, 'Reach' refers to:
options: How tall the staff is
The number of unique beneficiaries served by the program
The distance of the project from the city
How many donors were contacted
answer: The number of unique beneficiaries served by the program
hint: Service कितनी 'दूर' (far) तक गई?
explanation: Reach एक बुनियादी output metric है जो intervention (हस्तक्षेप) के पैमाने (scale) को दर्शाता है।

question: What is an 'Unintended Negative Impact'?
options: A project failing on purpose
An unexpected bad result of a well-intentioned program (e.g., waste generation from food distribution)
The NGO losing its registration
A donor withdrawing funds
answer: An unexpected bad result of a well-intentioned program (e.g., waste generation from food distribution)
hint: कुछ बुरा जो संयोग से (by accident) हुआ हो।
explanation: एक पूरी 'net' impact तस्वीर प्रदान करने के लिए Reports में unintended negative effects को भी कैप्चर (capture) किया जाना चाहिए।

question: The 'Executive Summary' of the report is meant for:
options: Only the auditor's boss
A quick overview of key findings for busy stakeholders
Filling space in the report
Listing the office expenses
answer: A quick overview of key findings for busy stakeholders
hint: 'Executives' के लिए एक 'summary' (सारांश)।
explanation: यह 1-2 पेजों में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण परिणामों (results), audit opinion, और key metrics को highlight करता है।

question: What is the 'Audit Evidence' section?
options: A list of physical objects
A description of the documents and data points that supported the auditor's findings
The NGO's furniture list
A collection of project photos only
answer: A description of the documents and data points that supported the auditor's findings
hint: दावों के पीछे का 'प्रमाण' (proof)।
explanation: हालाँकि तस्वीरें इसका हिस्सा हैं, audit evidence में data sheets, interview records, और financial receipts शामिल होते हैं।

question: The Social Auditor should maintain 'Professional Skepticism' throughout the reporting process.
options: True
False
Only if they find a mistake
Only for big NGOs
answer: True
hint: कभी भी data को वैसे ही न मान लें; हमेशा verification की तलाश करें।
explanation: Skepticism यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि auditor विरोधाभासों (contradictions) की तलाश करे और केवल management के दावों को आँख मूँद कर न मान ले।

question: What is 'Timeliness' in reporting?
options: The report being colorful
The report being issued while the information is still relevant to users
The auditor arriving on time
The project starting on time
answer: The report being issued while the information is still relevant to users
hint: पुरानी जानकारी बेकार जानकारी होती है।
explanation: Timely reporting यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि investors और stakeholders SE के वर्तमान (current) performance पर प्रतिक्रिया दे सकें।

question: The AIR must mention the 'Sustainable Development Goals' (SDGs) it contributes to.
options: True
False
Only for international NGOs
Only if the project is about the environment
answer: True
hint: यह दुनिया भर में impact को standardize करने में मदद करता है।
explanation: Social Stock Exchange पर AIR के लिए impact को SDGs के साथ map करना एक मानक आवश्यकता (standard requirement) है।

question: What is 'Conciseness' in a social audit report?
options: Being as long as possible
Providing the necessary information clearly and briefly without unnecessary filler
Using very small fonts
Skipping the financial section
answer: Providing the necessary information clearly and briefly without unnecessary filler
hint: पढ़ने में आसानी (readability) के लिए छोटा और सटीक (Short and sweet) होना बेहतर है।
explanation: एक concise report reader के समय का सम्मान करती है जबकि अपने findings में पूरी (complete) होती है।

question: Can an auditor provide 'Recommendations' in the Social Audit Report?
options: No, only findings
Yes, the auditor can suggest ways to improve social impact measurement and reporting
Only if they are paid extra as a consultant
Only if the NGO founder asks for them
answer: Yes, the auditor can suggest ways to improve social impact measurement and reporting
hint: Auditors संगठन (organization) को समय के साथ बेहतर होने में मदद करते हैं।
explanation: यद्यपि प्राथमिक लक्ष्य (primary goal) verification है, लेकिन बेहतर data management के लिए रचनात्मक (constructive) सुझाव देना अक्सर value-add का हिस्सा होता है।

question: What is the 'Audit Trail'?
options: A walking path in the project village
The step-by-step evidence that allows any outside person to trace how a finding was reached
A list of auditors who visited the site
The path from the NGO to the bank
answer: The step-by-step evidence that allows any outside person to trace how a finding was reached
hint: यह सबूतों का 'रास्ता' (bread crumbs) है।
explanation: एक मजबूत (robust) audit trail यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि audit स्वयं verifiable और पारदर्शी (transparent) है।

question: If an NGO misuses funds, where should this be reported in the Social Audit Report?
options: It shouldn't be reported
In the 'Findings' and reflected in the 'Audit Opinion'
In a secret letter to the donor only
In the local community gossip
answer: In the 'Findings' and reflected in the 'Audit Opinion'
hint: Funds का दुरुपयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण material fact है।
explanation: Auditor का कर्तव्य (duty) है कि वह formal report के माध्यम से board और संबंधित अधिकारियों को अनियमितताओं (irregularities) की रिपोर्ट करे।

question: Which of these is a 'Good Practice' for writing an AIR?
options: Using complex jargon to sound professional
Using simple language, charts, and infographics for better understanding
Using only black and white text with no images
Making the report 500 pages long
answer: Using simple language, charts, and infographics for better understanding
hint: Reports एक आम आदमी (layperson) के लिए पढ़ने में आसान होनी चाहिए।
explanation: Charts जैसे visual aids आम investor के लिए impact data को समझना बहुत आसान बना देते हैं।

question: What is 'Aggregated Data' in a report?
options: Individual stories of every person
Data combined from multiple sources or beneficiaries into a single summary figure (e.g., Total trained)
Data that is old and unusable
Data about the NGO's office pets
answer: Data combined from multiple sources or beneficiaries into a single summary figure (e.g., Total trained)
hint: कई व्यक्तिगत (individual) data points का सारांश (Summary)।
explanation: Aggregated data व्यक्तिगत गोपनीयता (privacy) की रक्षा करते हुए impact के समग्र पैमाने (overall scale) को दिखाने में मदद करता है।

question: The 'Social Stock Exchange segment' rules are the ultimate guide for what must be in a report.
options: True
False
Only for NPOs
Only for FPEs
answer: True
hint: Exchange अनिवार्य (mandatory) disclosure requirements तय करता है।
explanation: सभी listed enterprises को SSE और SEBI द्वारा निर्धारित विशिष्ट reporting formats और नियमों का पालन करना चाहिए।

question: What is the 'Verification Statement'?
options: A statement that the NGO is the best in the world
The auditor's formal declaration of the scope and findings of their work
A receipt for the auditor's fees
A letter from the local government
answer: The auditor's formal declaration of the scope and findings of their work
hint: यह audit report का दिल (heart) है।
explanation: यह statement संक्षेप में बताता है (summarizes) कि क्या verify किया गया था और auditor का conclusion क्या है।

question: Should the Social Audit Report mention the 'Risks' identified during the project?
options: No, it looks bad for the NGO
Yes, transparency about risks helps stakeholders understand the context of the results
Only if the project fails
Only if the donor asks
answer: Yes, transparency about risks helps stakeholders understand the context of the results
hint: Impact हवा (vacuum) में नहीं होता; हमेशा जोखिम (risks) होते हैं।
explanation: Risks (जैसे, मौसम संबंधी समस्याएं, राजनीतिक बदलाव) पर रिपोर्ट करने से पता चलता है कि assessment यथार्थवादी (realistic) और ईमानदार (honest) है।

question: Which of these is a quality of 'Effective' social reporting?
options: Clarity
Reliability
Comparability
All of the above
answer: All of the above
hint: ये अच्छी रिपोर्टिंग के मूलभूत (fundamental) लक्षण हैं।
explanation: अच्छी रिपोर्ट्स समझने में आसान, भरोसेमंद (trustworthy) होती हैं और उनकी दूसरों के साथ तुलना (compared) की जा सकती है।

question: What happens if a Social Auditor signs a 'False' report knowingly?
options: Nothing, they just get a warning
They can face legal action, fines, and lose their NISM/SRO certification
They get a bonus from the NGO
They are asked to write a better one next time
answer: They can face legal action, fines, and lose their NISM/SRO certification
hint: Professional कदाचार (misconduct) के गंभीर परिणाम होते हैं।
explanation: Financial markets के भरोसे के लिए audit profession की सत्यनिष्ठा (integrity) बनाए रखना बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है।

question: The 'Closing Meeting' of an audit is used to:
options: Have a party
Share and discuss the audit findings with management before the final report is signed
Ask for more money
Introduce the new project idea
answer: Share and discuss the audit findings with management before the final report is signed
hint: यह auditor और entity के बीच अंतिम 'debrief' (पूछताछ) है।
explanation: Closing meeting यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि management निष्कर्षों (findings) को समझता है और उसके पास अंतिम स्पष्टीकरण (final clarifications) देने का मौका है।
